Brief Note: Lumbricus terrestris Exposure to High-Density Microplastics

Short communication by L. Jansen, January 5, 2026.

In laboratory micro-mesocosm bioassays, common earthworms (Lumbricus terrestris) exposed to high-density polyethylene (HDPE) powder at 1,000 mg/kg dry soil exhibited a 14.5% decrease in body mass over 28 days compared to unexposed controls. Histological gut sectioning indicated mucosal abrasion and localized immune inflammation without acute mortality.
